items.title:
org.eclipse.dirigible:dirigible-components-core-liquibase 14.26.0 发布, Source of truth for the Dirigible system schema (DIRIGIBLE_*) running in SystemDB.
        Liquibase JSON changelogs in src/main/resources/db/changelog/ create and version every
        platform table; Hibernate is reduced to schema validation (DIRIGIBLE_DATABASE_SYSTEM_DDL_AUTO
        defaults to "validate") and no longer issues DDL during application startup.
        Dynamic user entities (TypeScript @Entity via data-store, Java @Entity via
        data-store-java) continue to use Hibernate's hbm2ddl=update because their schema is
        authored by end-user code, not by changelogs.

items.title:
org.eclipse.dirigible:dirigible-components-core-java 14.26.0 发布, Lightweight runtime primitives shared between components/engine/engine-java (the full
        client-Java engine — synchronizer, compiler, ClassConsumer SPI, controller routing) and
        components/engine/engine-bpm-flowable (only needs to resolve client-compiled classes from
        delegate expressions). Extracted from engine-java's runtime package so engine-bpm-flowable
        can depend on this small leaf module instead of the full engine — that in turn lets
        components/api/api-modules-java publish the org.eclipse.dirigible.sdk.* annotations to
        engine-java without forming a cycle through api-bpm.

se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-cli 1.2.0 发布, Companion command-line tool for VibeTags: `init` bootstraps a project's opt-in
        files (file presence is the opt-in signal the processor honours), `doctor`
        reports the project's VibeTags health — build-tool wiring, active platforms,
        marker integrity. Run it without installing anything:

            jbang se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-cli:1.2.0 init --list

        The platform list and marker rules are read from vibetags-processor, so this
        tool cannot drift from what the processor actually does.

items.title:
it.neckar.open:otel-agent-extension 10.1.0 发布, OpenTelemetry Java Agent extension — derives resource attributes from the runtime-context environment.

Packaged as a self-contained OTel autoconfigure ResourceProvider. The resulting JAR is loaded two ways,
both from the single NeckarRuntimeContextResourceProvider source:
  - deployed services: as an OTel Java Agent extension (-Dotel.javaagent.extensions=...), the only way the
    agent picks up a ResourceProvider (application-classpath providers are NOT loaded by the agent).
  - IDE / integration-test runs (no agent): via the plain autoconfigured SDK, which does load
    application-classpath providers — consumers depend on this module so the provider is on their classpath.

Intentionally free of first-party dependencies: the agent loads the extension in an isolated classloader
that has neither the application classpath nor other JARs, only the agent's own (shaded) OpenTelemetry SDK.
Everything the provider needs must live in this JAR, so the runtime-context env keys are inlined here rather
than referenced from it.neckar.runtime.context.RuntimeContextEnv.
